sharedStyle: Landscape 3:2 cover illustration for a veterinary clinical quick guide. Minimal pale warm-gray clinical background with a muted teal exam-table surface. Clean modern flat editorial illustration, simple geometric shapes, soft rounded outlines, restrained medical infographic aesthetic and subtle depth. Off-white, slate blue, muted teal, soft beige and minimal coral accents. Anatomically plausible positioning, calm non-distressed animal, non-graphic. No text, labels, arrows, logos or watermark. Avoid photography, photorealism, 3D render, exposed anatomy, blood and clutter.

assets.prompt: A calm medium-sized dog lying on its side while two gloved hands stabilize the distal femur and proximal tibia to perform a cranial drawer test. The knee and hand placement are easy to understand without internal tissue.

A calm dog in sternal recumbency, side view, with a small clipped lateral thoracic site. A gloved hand places a small pleural catheter connected to extension tubing, a three-way stopcock and an empty syringe.
A calm dog lying on its side or back with a small clipped ventral abdominal site. One gloved hand holds an ultrasound probe while another places a fine sampling needle connected to a syringe.

A calm dog lying on its side while a veterinarian wraps a thick, even layer of white orthopedic cotton from the toes upward. Emphasize the bulky padded cylindrical Robert Jones bandage and leave the toes exposed for monitoring.

A calm dog lying on its side with one rear paw extended. One gloved hand stabilizes the metatarsal region while another holds a small heparinized blood-gas syringe at a shallow angle over the dorsal pedal artery. No visible blood.

A calm anesthetized dog lying on its side with a small clipped sterile field over the iliac crest. Gloved hands hold a recognizable T-handled Jamshidi-style needle perpendicular to the landmark, with a syringe and blank microscope slides nearby.

A calm sedated female dog in sternal recumbency with hind limbs gently extended over the table edge, viewed obliquely from the rear side. A veterinarian uses a penlight and thin flexible urinary catheter, with the intimate area covered by a sterile drape.

A calm anesthetized dog in lateral recumbency with the head and neck carefully flexed and stabilized. A gloved hand holds a slim spinal needle at the dorsal atlanto-occipital region, with three empty sample tubes nearby.

A calm sedated male cat lying on its side, partly covered by a sterile drape. Gloved hands manage a short flexible urinary catheter connected through clear tubing and a three-way stopcock to a saline syringe for careful pulsed flushing.

A calm sedated male dog in lateral recumbency with a sterile drape covering the pelvic area. Gloved hands guide a long flexible urinary catheter toward a closed clear urine collection bag below the table.

A calm anesthetized dog lying on its side with a small clipped sterile field on the lateral trunk. Two gloved hands use fine forceps and a small scalpel to remove a narrow wedge-shaped sample from the border between a rounded superficial mass and normal skin, with a plain histology container nearby.
